verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only single-item actions: API endpoints for creating and updating tasks, one-click assign, and per-task deadline adjustment. It also shows adjacent features: filtering and sorting, and automatic rescheduling of the whole day. None of these is a documented user-facing bulk-edit or batch API capability for acting on many items at once, so the API counts only as a developer building block and the rescheduling as an adjacent automation.
